description: Java class SearchSourceBuilder used for building SearchSource instances with configurable search parameters including filters, sort options, fields, and timeout settings in a Ditto-based search service.

classes.name: SearchSourceBuilder
classes.description: A final class that provides a builder pattern for constructing SearchSource objects with specified search parameters such as filters, sort criteria, fields, namespaces, and related timeouts in a Ditto service environment.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a SearchSource instance with the specified parameters, ensuring required fields are set and valid.

methods.name: pubSubMediator
methods.description: Sets the pub-sub mediator ActorRef used for error reporting.

methods.name: conciergeForwarder
methods.description: Sets the ActorRef for the concierge forwarder to send commands.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Sets the selected fields for search results either directly via JsonFieldSelector or via a comma-separated string.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Sets the filter string used for search queries, validated for correctness.

methods.name: namespaces
methods.description: Sets the namespaces for the search either directly as a JsonArray or via a comma-separated string.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sets the sort option from a string, using default if null or empty.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Sets sort options and fields from a comma-separated options string.

methods.name: sortValues
methods.description: Sets the sort values used for cursor-based pagination.

methods.name: dittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders object, including headers like authorization and correlation ID.

methods.name: thingsAskTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration when querying the things shard region.

methods.name: searchAskTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for search actor requests.

methods.name: lastThingId
methods.description: Sets the last thing ID to resume or paginate search results.
